question: How many month-to-month transitions into 2005-09 were worsening?
reference_query: MATCH (:MonthlyCreditRecord)-[r:NEXT_MONTH]->(b:MonthlyCreditRecord {month: '2005-09'}) WHERE r.status_change = 'worsening' RETURN count(r) AS n

question: How many customers had a 2005-09 bill larger than their credit limit?
reference_query: MATCH (m:MonthlyCreditRecord {month: '2005-09'}) WHERE m.utilization > 1 RETURN count(m) AS n

question: How many customers were never late in any of the six months?
reference_query: MATCH (a:CreditAccount)-[:HAS_MONTHLY_RECORD]->(m:MonthlyCreditRecord) WITH a, sum(CASE WHEN m.is_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late WHERE late = 0 RETURN count(a) AS n

question: In which months was this customer late?
reference_query: MATCH (:CreditAccount {account_id: $cid})-[:HAS_MONTHLY_RECORD]->(m:MonthlyCreditRecord) WHERE m.is_late RETURN m.month AS month ORDER BY month

question: What was this customer's longest run of consecutive late months?
reference_query: MATCH (:CreditAccount {account_id: $cid})-[:HAS_MONTHLY_RECORD]->(m:MonthlyCreditRecord) WITH m ORDER BY m.month_index WITH collect(m.is_late) AS l RETURN reduce(s = {best: 0, cur: 0}, x IN l | CASE WHEN x THEN {best: CASE WHEN s.cur + 1 > s.best THEN s.cur + 1 ELSE s.best END, cur: s.cur + 1} ELSE {best: s.best, cur: 0} END).best AS n
